notes: Data Steward verified 2026-09-10: all 11 tables use `trading_date` as the date column (guessed names were correct); no column-name fixes were needed. Two schema hazards found and documented below: (1) market_regime_daily carries THREE regime_version rows per trading_date for 2026-01-02..2026-06-08 (v1/v1.1/v1.2), all written by a same-day backfill on 2026-06-02/2026-06-08 — there is NO point-in-time regime label on record for any night before 2026-06-09; only v1.2 rows from 2026-06-09 onward are same-night live writes. SELECT * intentionally keeps all versions for lineage; consumers must NOT treat pre-2026-06-09 rows as point-in-time. (2) sas_selection_excursion.computed_at shows recomputation weeks/months after trading_date (not a fixed 1-session lag) — confirmed OUTCOME-only, never a feature, consistent with existing note.
in_sample_end_rationale: Last trading date of May 2026 (per super_agent_select_runs). CLAUDE.md records April-May 2026 as a strong tape and June-August as materially weaker; splitting at the April/May-June boundary keeps the strong tape entirely in-sample and puts the weaker, larger June-Sep10 stretch out-of-sample — the conservative direction for an OOS test per Q001 PREREG §6/§8. Set by data-steward per protocol; Q001's PREREG is not yet locked and this value is provisional until Haci locks it.

sas_candidates.note: written live at decision time; point-in-time by construction. Verified: sampled created_at/updated_at cluster same trading_date evening.

sas_excursion.note: OUTCOME table — never a feature. CORRECTION 2026-09-10: computed_at sampling shows the true lag is NOT a fixed 1 session — rows are recomputed repeatedly over weeks/months as the excursion window matures (e.g. trading_date 2026-04-21 recomputed at 2026-07-05 and again later). "lag_sessions: 1" understates this; treat as variable/never-a-feature, not next-day-available.

conviction_monitor.note: next-session signal; feature only for t+1 decisions. Verified: created_at is same trading_date ~16:02 ET for a 20-row random sample, no exceptions.

market_regime.note: CORRECTED 2026-09-10: this is only true for regime_version='v1.2' rows with trading_date >= 2026-06-09 (created_at same-day ~16:05 ET, verified on a random sample, one late-write exception on 2026-07-06 posted 2026-07-07 14:23 UTC). For trading_date <= 2026-06-08 there is NO point-in-time row at all — all v1/v1.1/v1.2 rows for that period were written by a backfill on 2026-06-02/2026-06-08. Do not use market_regime_daily as a knowledge-time-compliant feature before 2026-06-09; validator V3's revised-column block does not protect against this because the hazard is a wholesale missing-then-backfilled history, not a same-day revision.

uoa_symbol.note: OI confirmation columns are NEXT-MORNING data: lag_sessions=1 for any *_oi_* column. Verified: in a 15-row sample, oi_confirm_* fields always postdate created_at (updated_at ranges from next-day to several weeks later for older backfilled rows) — never same-day, so no leak, but "next-morning" understates how late some historical rows were finalized.

whale_ledger.note: OUTCOME table. Verified 2026-09-10: table is EMPTY (0 rows) — confirms CLAUDE.md's known finding "whale ledger empty."

outcome_corrections.note: never a feature. SQL corrected 2026-09-10 to add the trading_date <= :as_of filter (was previously pulling the full table unscoped); 0 of 795 rows have a null trading_date so the filter is safe.

universe_membership_note: Candidate universe is generated live nightly from engines; no reconstructed universe. If any table is backfilled, record universe_membership_asof here. FLAG: market_regime_daily trading_date <= 2026-06-08 is entirely backfilled (see availability.market_regime note) — universe_membership_asof for that slice = 2026-06-02 (v1) / 2026-06-08 (v1.1, v1.2).
